name: betterCode() PHP 2026
description: heise one-day online PHP conference: PHP 8.6, Composer security, AI modernization
note: online, German and English; early-bird and team discount in the shop; online workshops 4, 8, 10 Dec
details:
The heise conference on PHP, held online in the browser; videos and slides afterwards.

Program: Joe Ferguson (PHP 8.6 release manager) on what is new and removed in PHP 8.6; Sebastian Bergmann on Composer supply-chain security; Arne Blankerts on observability; Stefan Priebsch on modernizing legacy code with AI; Elizabeth Barron (The PHP Foundation) on the future of PHP; closing panel. Workshops: Composer dependency management (4 Dec), "Stop Logging, Start Observing" (8 Dec), modernizing legacy PHP with AI (10 Dec, full day). Prices only in the ticket shop.
